## 50 Years of Collaboration, Teamwork, and Partnership

In 1976, Henry Kravis and George Roberts co-founded KKR alongside their mentor Jerome Kohlberg. Today KKR is a global, with multiple types of capital that are invested all over the world on behalf of our clients, and those investments are helping address the some of the world's most pressing challenges.

[Our History](https://www.kkr.com/about/history)

Who we serve

We provide alternative asset management and capital markets solutions for a wide range of companies and clients.

- Institutional Investors



Our differentiated investment insights, time-tested approach, and wide array of solutions help pensions, sovereign wealth funds, endowments and foundations, consultants, and insurance companies fulfill their missions.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.kkr.com/about/institutional-investors)

- Global Wealth



Our Global Wealth Solutions for eligible individual investors across private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and real estate draw on an investment process honed over nearly five decades and many market cycles.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.kkr.com/about/global-wealth-solutions)

- Family Capital



Our global Family Capital team is dedicated to helping families and entrepreneurs find solutions for their unique investment needs.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.kkr.com/about/family-capital)

- Companies



The companies we invest in benefit from more than just our capital. As trusted partners, we aim to help them achieve operational excellence and provide expertise across a variety of industries and markets.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.kkr.com/invest/portfolio)
